welcome_lead: There are about 8 billion of us! Where do we all live? Discover megacities and how the world is growing.

walkthroughs.body_html: In 2022, the global population passed 8 billion. It's still growing, especially in Africa and Asia.
A megacity has over 10 million people. Tokyo, Delhi, Shanghai and São Paulo are huge examples.
People cluster in coasts, river valleys and lowlands. Sparse areas include deserts, mountains and polar regions.
